findings.title: Caller-provided AbortSignal is overwritten, breaking external cancellation
findings.evidence: The fetch call now always passes a newly created controller signal, replacing any signal supplied in options. A caller that previously used fetchJson(url, { signal }) to cancel on unmount, shutdown, or request fan-out can no longer abort the request, changing the function's contract and causing requests to continue unexpectedly until the internal timeout or completion.
findings.evidence_quote: const response = await fetch(url, { ...options, signal: controller.signal });
findings.recommendation: Preserve and compose the caller's signal with the timeout signal instead of overwriting it. For example, if options.signal exists, create a combined signal that aborts when either the caller signal or the timeout controller aborts; otherwise pass the timeout signal alone.
